title: explain-fields: Add failure_modes, durability, retry_safe fields to explain output
description: Feature P1-10. Master §75 (explain Command) defines the WorkflowExplanation schema: per-step {id, kind, action, reads, writes, max_calls, taint, idempotency, strict_durable, retry_safety}, top-level {failure_modes: [{step, errors}], durability: {side_effects_journaled_before_dispatch, replay_safe}}. Today cmd_explain emits kind: 'explain_report' instead of 'WorkflowExplanation' and lacks the §75 fields. The explain output is the AI agent's primary planning input (per master §75: 'Output includes: what the workflow does, what actions it calls, what secrets it touches, what can fail, what is durable, what is safe to retry'). This bead adds the missing per-step fields (walks the IR via compiled.nodes), the top-level durability, the per-step failure_modes (derived from action contract), and changes kind to 'WorkflowExplanation'. Depends on P0-4 (action contract must be well-defined for the per-step failure_modes derivation).

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit a WorkflowExplanation with per-step {idempotency, strict_durable, retry_safety} for every Do step
THE SYSTEM SHALL emit a top-level durability block with {side_effects_journaled_before_dispatch, replay_safe} for every accepted workflow

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb explain workflow.yaml --emit yaml`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit a WorkflowExplanation with kind: 'WorkflowExplanation', per-step fields per master §75, and a top-level durability block

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a Do step references an action with a SideEffect::ExternalWrite contract
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the step as strict_durable: true and durability.side_effects_journaled_before_dispatch: true

unwanted.condition: IF a Do step has an action with no registered contract
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT emit strict_durable: false as a default; it must emit a typed MissingContract error
unwanted.because: Master §65: 'Every retry requires idempotency proof' — missing contract means no proof, which is a hard failure

unwanted.condition: IF the workflow has zero Do steps
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT emit a failure_modes array of length 0 without an explanatory note; it must emit failure_modes: [] with a top-level note 'no external actions; all failures are local'
unwanted.because: AI agents reading the explain output need to know whether failure_modes is empty intentionally or by oversight

preconditions: Workflow YAML compiles to a CompiledWorkflow (passes gate 2 = shape)
All Do steps have a registered action contract (passes gate 9 = contracts; depends on P0-4)
postconditions: Each Do step has: idempotency, retry_safety, strict_durable, failure_modes (list of error codes)
Top-level durability.side_effects_journaled_before_dispatch is true iff at least one Do step has SideEffect::ExternalWrite
invariants: Per-step failure_modes is derived from the action contract's SideEffect + RetrySafety, not hand-curated
durability.replay_safe is true iff every Do step has Idempotency::IdempotentExternal OR Idempotency::DeterministicPure (no AtLeastOnceExternal without a proof)

happy: explain_emits_workflow_explanation_kind: `vb explain foo.yaml --emit yaml | jq .kind` returns 'WorkflowExplanation'
explain_includes_per_step_idempotency_retry_safety: a workflow with 2 Do steps produces 2 entries with both fields populated
explain_includes_durability_block: `vb explain foo.yaml --emit yaml | jq .durability` returns {side_effects_journaled_before_dispatch, replay_safe}
error: explain_with_missing_contract_returns_missing_contract_error: depends on P0-4; explain of a workflow with a contract-less Do returns MissingContract
explain_with_invalid_workflow_returns_validation_error: a malformed YAML fails at parse, not at explain
edge: explain_proptest_output_shape_locks_down_schema: 5 fixtures, all produce the same WorkflowExplanation shape

files: crates/vb_compile/src/compiled.rs (CompiledWorkflow.nodes; the source of truth for steps)
crates/vb_runtime/src/action.rs (ActionContract: idempotency, side_effect, retry_safety; the source of truth for per-step fields)
patterns: Pattern: walking compiled.nodes with a for_each_node iterator (used by simulate in P1-12)
Pattern: existing JSON output uses 'kind' as a discriminator; master §75 specifies 'WorkflowExplanation' for explain output
questions: Should the per-step failure_modes include only the action's contract error codes, or also workflow-level errors (e.g., MissingNextStep)? (Spec: action contract codes only; workflow-level errors are a separate diagnostic.)

security_failures.failure: An attacker submits a workflow with a Do step that has a DeterministicPure contract but reads a Secret slot; the explain output should flag this as a taint violation
security_failures.prevention: Per-step failure_modes includes 'TAINT_VIOLATION' for any Do step where input taint violates the contract

usability_failures.failure: AI agent reads explain output but doesn't know which steps are strict_durable (so it can't prioritize durability review)
usability_failures.prevention: strict_durable is a boolean per step, populated from the contract

data_integrity_failures.failure: Per-step failure_modes is hand-curated and drifts from the actual contract
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Derived automatically from the contract; no hand-edited list

integration_failures.failure: External tool reads explain output and expects kind == 'explain_report' (the old name)
integration_failures.prevention: Schema version field tells the tool which version; both 'explain_report' and 'WorkflowExplanation' are accepted for v1, with 'WorkflowExplanation' preferred

phase_0: Read crates/vb_compile/src/compiled.rs to find the CompiledWorkflow.nodes structure
Read crates/vb_runtime/src/action.rs to find the ActionContract enum
phase_2: In cmd_explain: walk compiled.nodes, emit per-step entries with {id, kind, action, reads, writes, max_calls, taint, idempotency, retry_safety, strict_durable, failure_modes}
In cmd_explain: emit top-level durability block: {side_effects_journaled_before_dispatch, replay_safe}
In cmd_explain: change kind from 'explain_report' to 'WorkflowExplanation'
phase_3: Update master §75 example to match the new output (no schema break, just clarifying the kind name)
phase_4: Run `moon run :test -p vb_cli` and verify all new tests pass
Manual: `vb explain fixtures/issue_triage.yaml --emit yaml | jq .kind` returns 'WorkflowExplanation'

similar_implementations: simulate command (P1-12) walks the same compiled.nodes; share the iterator

key_sections_to_understand: Current kind field and how it's set

apis_that_exist: ActionContract { idempotency, side_effect, retry_safety } in vb_runtime/src/action.rs
apis_that_do_not_exist: There is no WorkflowExplanation struct today; this bead defines it
no_placeholder_values: Do NOT use 'various' or 'multiple' for failure_modes; enumerate the actual error codes
